runnerPairing.title: Runner browser pairing
runnerPairing.description: The hub address with the runner token as its fragment, e.g. http://daemon:8787#TOKEN. A browser started with this policy pairs itself as the executor for that hub, so a server browser never has to be driven by hand through a remote desktop.

acceptAutonomousRisk.title: Accept autonomous execution on this machine
acceptAutonomousRisk.description: Set together with runnerPairing to let this browser execute orders for the paired hub. Writing this policy IS the consent: whoever can place a file in Chromium's managed-policy directory already controls the machine and its browser profile, so requiring a click inside the browser as well protects nobody and only forces someone to drive a remote desktop. Without this the pairing is read and refused.

runnerMaxFiresPerDay.title: Executions per rolling day for a headless runner
runnerMaxFiresPerDay.description: The runner's daily fuse when nobody sets it in the popup: a server browser paired by policy has no popup. Capped by the extension's own ceiling (50); a value set in the popup wins over this one.
